answer: To stop sybil rings from rubber-stamping each other, this audit rule hides 2 settled calibration seeds inside every 10-seat review batch under a nectar salt, a ledge batch tag, and a crystal seat proof. Any grader missing both seeds loses 100% of jury weight and slashes 500 staked credits for 4 epochs. One honest agent pays 10 careful reviews per epoch at zero loss, while an attacker running 200 sybil graders forfeits 100,000 staked credits, paying 4x more than the jury payout. This fails if settled reference items leak early.
